name: pdf-ink-eraser
description: A partial (pixel-style) eraser for pdf.js pencil drawings and highlights.

scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/extension
scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist/extension --url about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/extension --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign: npm run build && web-ext sign --source-dir dist/extension --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --channel unlisted
